description: The new perplexity helper uses vocabulary size as the bound while slicing the sequence axis.
trigger: The number of prediction positions exceeds vocabulary size; larger vocabularies instead produce unnecessary trailing empty slices.
expected_behavior: Accumulate every next-token prediction exactly once by iterating over logits_.shape[0].
actual_behavior: The loop stops at logits_.shape[1]. For 2047 prediction positions and vocabulary size 1024, its bounds cover only 1024 targets.

verification.description: The diff shows logits shaped by selecting one row and removing the final sequence position, then ppl slicing axis zero while bounding on axis one. Its only direct call in the diff is main’s per-model loop. Whole-parent-tree searches found no model_diff references and no pre-existing caller of this new nested helper; the inspected script directly invokes main from its CLI guard.
verification.limits: Text searches do not establish external or dynamic callers.

verification.description: A standard-library bounds model counted 1024 of 2047 positions for vocabulary 1024; vocabulary 32000 covered all 2047 positions but required four iterations.
verification.limits: This models slicing bounds only; it does not execute the repository helper or establish Torch behavior on empty tensors.
